crossRefs.note: Israel, trust in Yahweh! He is their help and their shield.
House of Israel, praise Yahweh! House of Aaron, praise Yahweh!
House of Levi, praise Yahweh! You who fear Yahweh, praise Yahweh!
All your works will give thanks to you, Yahweh. Your saints will extol you.
He shows his word to Jacob, his statutes and his ordinances to Israel.
He has not done this for just any nation. They don’t know his ordinances. Praise Yah!
As many as walk by this rule, peace and mercy be on them, and on God’s Israel.
Through him, then, let’s offer up a sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of lips which proclaim…
But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim…
In the past, you were not a people, but now are God’s people, who had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: Let Israel now say that his loving kindness endures forever.
translations.bsb: Let Israel say, “His loving devotion endures forever.”
translations.kjv: Let Israel now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.
translations.asv: Let Israel now say, That his lovingkindness endureth for ever.
